company.name: 10by10.io
company.shortDescription: 10by10 uses AI to quickly match qualified candidates with companies by aggregating data across recruitment agencies.
company.description:
Not enough qualified candidates apply through your job site and job boards are full of mediocre unqualified candidates. 10by10 uses technology, AI and automation, hand in hand with the best technical recruiters to source highly qualified candidates in half of the time. Contact us to see our sample A+ candidates.

*For Employers*
-Simply provide us with your job req and with our in-take process, we'll immediately start aggregating top talent. We'll ONLY send you candidates who are vetted, qualified, and interview-ready. 70% of the candidates we send to our clients go straight through to the interview process. Time is money and we don't like wasting yours.

*For Recruiters*
-Once vetted to join our platform you are able to submit ideal candidates to our open job reqs.  You get high placement fee for only souring and vetting candidates.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $120,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,630,892 to $2,630,892, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Mercor, SmartRecruiters, Lever.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
